messages:
Nadia: Noticed a bunch of tenants showing negative "quota heartbeat" deltas in the preview console this morning. Final invoices look fine but previews have -tokens spikes. Started after a routing-priority tweak last night.

Omar: I saw that. Route-priority now tags `priority=burst` for certain short sessions. Metering pipeline uses (tenant, route) key but quota-heartbeat consumer uses (tenant, route, priority) leading to split aggregates.

Li: Short repro: preview aggregator groups by full envelope so a route switch from `nlp-us` -> `nlp-us|burst` creates separate buckets; final billing normalizer canonicalizes priority away.

Priya: Sample envelope (sanitized):
```json
{"tenant":"T-77","route":"nlp-us","priority":"burst","tokens":120}
```

BillingBot: Logged 129 preview anomalies, net invoice impact 0.2% of daily revenue. Customers saw preview only.

Nadia: UX problem: console shows preview totals without explanation and CS got tickets. We should add an annotation when routing attributes change and a banner: "Preview totals may differ from final invoices while we roll out routing updates."

Omar: Fixes: 1) Make aggregator attribution key explicit service-side to ignore `priority` for metering; 2) Add preview normalization to drop ephemeral attrs; 3) Add alert when preview_vs_final > 5% for tenants > $500/mo.

Li: I'll submit PR to aggregation service to canonicalize keys (backward-compatible flag). Will include a migration that reconciles 24h of preview windows by replaying normalized envelopes.

Priya: Ops, can we gate the change with a feature-flag and roll to canary first? Also need console annotation hook when flag flips.

OncallBot: Created PAGE-3890. Paging infra to run canary and schedule backfill.

DevexBot: Added test-case to preview-integration: inject ephemeral `priority` values and assert preview shows "estimated" badge + annotation.

Nadia: Action items: Li -> PR + backfill job; Omar -> make priority non-attributional in route-resolver or add header `x-metering-key`; Ops -> canary rollout; Priya -> console banner + CS note.

Omar: I'll also add telemetry for percent of envelopes with priority tag so we can monitor rollout impact.

Nadia: Thanks. Let's aim for canary tonight and dry-run backfill before applying.
